BiblicalUsage: Once in each genealogy, a duke of Edom: these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth. The name is a chief of Esau's line, counted among the dukes, and the count is all the Bible says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A duke named twice in the lists carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the order of Edom, that Esau's chiefs are named by their families and their places.
